summary: QNB Corp. filed an 8-K on September 8, 2026, announcing a strategic repositioning of a portion of its available-for-sale securities portfolio. The Company sold securities with $254.4 million amortized cost at a 1.59% weighted average yield and is redeploying proceeds into higher-yielding securities and loan growth at a blended expected yield of 5.45%. The repositioning triggers an estimated $26.2 million pre-tax loss in Q3 2026, expected to be recovered in under four years. No advisor, board recommendation, or regulatory clock was disclosed. Watch for Q3 earnings impact, capital ratios, and whether the yield pickup materializes as projected.
